method: Separate script recomputing headline numbers by different code paths: rate in float64, H(X), distortion with another MC seed and hand-written Bernoulli NLL (4 SE), beta*, Q7 count, MI by explicit joint tables with hand-written 20-bin discretization, units per block, F1 fact counts from stored pw03a matrices, b_lin eigenvalue counts by SVD, Q6 funnel per sample with the pw01 checker and hand-written cross-block code, independence prediction by Monte Carlo (4 SE), one model's samples regenerated with the frozen pw04a sampler (byte comparison). Negative controls: uniform random bits through the funnel; permuted block labels for MI.
limitations: Same author and session (not independent replication); same retained operands as the analysis; per-cell summaries, null percentiles, signs and pair classes not recomputed.
